scope: Six reused FFHQ development image clusters, two dependent seeds each; final unroll only. Discrepancy-inspired same-time surrogate, not a proven next-state constraint, exact Jacobian, curvature or reconstruction optimum. Targets .9/1/1.1 are model-mismatch sensitivity settings, not noise confidence bounds.
selection_objective: First noise-target crossing, then stop measurement guidance; ray minimum only when target unreachable; unresolved response keeps gamma1.
